# If you’re already in it

If you’re already married, living together, raising children, or ten years in, obviously you can’t go back and date more slowly. You have to start where you are.

The part I learned the hard way in all three relationships was that I could keep bringing up the same problem forever and still not make the other person look at it with me. One person can’t create mutual honesty.

With Bee and Key, the biggest thing sitting underneath everything was trust. They wanted to be with me and would say they trusted me, but really they didn’t trust me, themself, or anyone else. It was all or nothing: blind trust, or none.
